admission.justification: Browser admission and independent server validation prevent an oversized pick from retaining bytes or reaching a file/send path, with focused bound/refused-write assertions.

applicability: Dashboard collection and Send bounds, plus independent server request/image/message limits.
conditions: Local dashboard bounds are positive whole numbers, defaulting to 20 picks, 5 MiB per image and 20 MiB per message; invalid input is refused and Reset restores defaults.
Collection refuses excess count/type/image/message contributions by name before storing refused image bytes, and Send rechecks current bounds.
The server bounds the streamed request before parsing, validates supported image type and decoded bytes, and refuses over-limit picks/images/messages before filing.
exclusions: Browser encoded-size estimates and server decoded-byte accounting are not identical.
Local bounds are browser preferences, not AR operator settings.
Changing a bound does not silently remove existing picks.
